MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[North Central Railway (Contruction Department) ] 
NOTIFICATION 
Prayagraj, the 27th December, 2024 

S.O. II(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 20A of the Railways 
Act, 989 (24 of 989) Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (l! of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given 
in the schedule annexed here to, is required for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of 
the Special Railway Project namely Dholpur- Sirmathura Gauge conversion in District Dholpur in the State of 
Rajasthan hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 

Any whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “Rajasthan 
Patrika” and “Danik Bhaskar” on dated 07.08.2024 under sub section (4) of Section 20A of the said Act. 

And objections were received as per subsection () of section 20D. In which 05 objections were received in 
village Narpura, 0l objections in village Tagawali and no objections were received in villages Sandra, Sirdamapur, 
Jirauli, Surajpura of Tehsil Dholpur and objections were received 02 no’s in village Nidhara, l4 no’s in village Bari, 
02 no’s in village Vidarpur, 0l no. in village Gadhijkhoda, and 02 no’s in village Kuhawani and no objections were 
received in village Bijauli, Mauhari, Hussainpura, Rajapur, Bateswarkalan, Kherari, Ibrahimpur, Tamouti, Dhimari, 
Dhannu Ka Pura, Khule Ka Pura, Kachpura, Hallekapura, Sikarra, Chilachand of Tehsil Bari and all the above 
objections were heard as per law, orders have been passed by the competent authority under subsection (2) of 20D. 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Auhority, and in exercise of the powers 
confereed by sub-section (l) of section-20 ‘E’ of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. 

And __ urther, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on the publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the lands specified in the Schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.
